releaseReviewUse.intendedConsumer: Node read-only capture release evidence review
releaseReviewUse.reason: This guide explains field semantics only; it is not a live upstream probe result.

fields.meaning: Java application name exposed to the control plane.
Java application version string. Default is 0.1.0-SNAPSHOT unless build metadata overrides it.
Active Spring profiles, or default profiles when no active profile is set.
Current Java process start instant.
Seconds from process start to sampling time; should be non-negative.
Primary Java health probe endpoint.
Required HTTP method for the health probe.
Expected actuator health status value.
false in live /api/v1/ops/evidence, true in static sample JSON.
Version for Java read-only live probe window semantics.

Node must not automatically start Java.

Node write actions are outside the read-only window.
true only in live /api/v1/ops/evidence; false in static samples.
Java evidence does not grant production operations.
Node must use UPSTREAM_PROBES_ENABLED=true and UPSTREAM_ACTIONS_ENABLED=false.
Version for Java create-order idempotency boundary semantics.
Version for the Java IdempotencyStore abstraction that hides the active idempotency persistence implementation.
HTTP header required by POST /api/v1/orders.
Canonical request fingerprint version used to compare same-key create-order requests.
Same key plus same request replays the existing order without a second inventory reservation or Outbox event.
Same key plus different request is rejected with a stable conflict error code.
The currently active idempotency store. v53 keeps this on the Java JPA database path.
Execution mode for the active idempotency store implementation.
Ordered store list: the active Java database store plus disabled future candidates such as mini-kv TTL tokens.
mini-kv is not connected to the Java order transaction in this version.
